faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about our products.
faq.q1: Where can I buy By Aurum Girls products?
faq.a1: You can order all our products directly from our website, delivered anywhere in Azerbaijan via Azərpoçt.
faq.a2: Yes! Our honey, jams, and teas are made by our rural women using traditional methods, with no chemical additives whatsoever.
faq.a3: Delivery via Azərpoçt usually takes 3-5 business days. Within Baku it can sometimes arrive sooner.
faq.a4: Yes, we're open to partnering with retailers who share our values. Select "Wholesale Inquiry" as the topic and reach out through our contact form.
